reference: ORBIT TILE - FICTIONAL EXHIBIT MATERIAL
Each exhibit tile contains 37 ml of imaginary shimmer.
Caution: Never expose the exhibit tile to violet lamps.
Do not remove the exhibit tile from its paper tray.
The fabric wrapper preserves the fictional exhibit during transport.
The booklet depicts a colourful ornamental item.
